# Gizmodo
> Gizmodo is a technology, science, and culture publication covering breaking news, reviews, analysis, and entertainment.

Gizmodo publishes reporting and commentary on consumer technology, artificial intelligence, privacy, transportation, space, science, gadgets, and internet culture. It also includes io9, its entertainment vertical focused on sci-fi, fantasy, comics, TV, and movies, plus product recommendations, deals, downloads, and newsletters.

## Core Pages
- [Homepage](https://gizmodo.com): Main front page featuring top stories, featured posts, and current coverage across all desks.
- [Latest](https://gizmodo.com/latest): Reverse-chronological feed of the newest stories published across Gizmodo categories.
- [Tech News](https://gizmodo.com/tech): Central technology news hub covering platforms, devices, policy, and digital culture.
- [Reviews](https://gizmodo.com/reviews): Product reviews, hands-on impressions, and evaluations of consumer technology and services.
- [Science](https://gizmodo.com/science): Science reporting on research, health, climate, archaeology, and space exploration.
- [io9](https://gizmodo.com/io9): Entertainment vertical covering sci-fi, fantasy, comics, television, film, and fandom.

## Technology Topics
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://gizmodo.com/tech/artificial-intelligence): News and analysis on AI models, tools, regulation, safety, and industry competition.
- [Cryptocurrencies](https://gizmodo.com/tech/cryptocurrencies): Coverage of crypto markets, regulation, scams, exchanges, and blockchain-related developments.
- [Gadgets](https://gizmodo.com/tech/gadgets): Reporting on phones, laptops, wearables, smart home devices, and other consumer electronics.
- [Privacy & Security](https://gizmodo.com/tech/privacy-and-security): Articles on cybersecurity, surveillance, data breaches, privacy tools, and online safety.
- [Transportation](https://gizmodo.com/tech/transportation): Coverage of EVs, autonomous vehicles, airlines, transit, and transportation technology.
- [Tech](https://gizmodo.com/tech): Broader technology desk page aggregating major stories across Gizmodo’s tech reporting.

## Science & Space
- [Science](https://gizmodo.com/science): Main science section with research news, climate coverage, and scientific discoveries.
- [Space](https://gizmodo.com/science/space): Spaceflight and astronomy coverage focused on NASA, SpaceX, missions, and celestial events.
- [Science Archive](https://gizmodo.com/science): Ongoing stream of science stories spanning biology, physics, medicine, and Earth science.
- [Space Archive](https://gizmodo.com/science/space): Dedicated archive of space reporting, launches, telescopes, and planetary exploration.

## Entertainment & Pop Culture
- [io9](https://gizmodo.com/io9): Main io9 hub for genre entertainment, fandom, and speculative fiction coverage.
- [Morning Spoilers](https://gizmodo.com/tag/morning-spoilers): Recurring roundup of entertainment news, trailers, casting, and franchise updates.
- [io9 Archive](https://gizmodo.com/io9): Stream of io9 stories on comics, TV, movies, games, and collectibles.
- [Tag: Morning Spoilers](https://gizmodo.com/tag/morning-spoilers): Tag page collecting all installments of the Morning Spoilers series.

## Reviews, Buying Guides & Recommendations
- [Reviews](https://gizmodo.com/reviews): Editorial reviews of hardware, software, services, and connected devices.
- [Best VPN](https://gizmodo.com/best-vpn): Buying guide comparing VPN providers, features, pricing, and privacy considerations.
- [Best Cloud Storage](https://gizmodo.com/best-cloud-storage): Guide to cloud storage services with comparisons of security, speed, and value.
- [Best eSIM Provider](https://gizmodo.com/best-esim-provider): Guide to eSIM services for travel, mobile connectivity, and plan selection.
- [Deals](https://gizmodo.com/deals): Curated discounts and shopping coverage for gadgets, software, and home tech.

## Utilities & Reader Services
- [Downloads](https://gizmodo.com/download/): Software and app download hub with related utility and product coverage.
- [Newsletters](https://gizmodo.com/newsletters): Newsletter signup page for recurring editorial updates and curated story digests.
- [Latest](https://gizmodo.com/latest): Quick way to monitor newly published stories across all Gizmodo sections.
- [Deals](https://gizmodo.com/deals): Shopping-focused page surfacing current discounts, promotions, and product offers.

## Topic Tags & Recurring Coverage
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://gizmodo.com/tech/artificial-intelligence): Topic page for AI reporting, model launches, policy debates, and safety concerns.
- [Privacy & Security](https://gizmodo.com/tech/privacy-and-security): Topic page for hacks, breaches, privacy regulation, and digital security advice.
- [Transportation](https://gizmodo.com/tech/transportation): Topic page for EV launches, self-driving systems, and mobility industry news.
- [Space](https://gizmodo.com/science/space): Topic page for launches, astronomy, planetary science, and commercial spaceflight.
- [Morning Spoilers](https://gizmodo.com/tag/morning-spoilers): Recurring entertainment roundup useful for tracking franchise and casting news.

## Editorial Coverage Areas
- [Tech News](https://gizmodo.com/tech): Reporting on major technology companies, platforms, devices, and policy developments.
- [Science](https://gizmodo.com/science): Coverage of scientific research, climate issues, health findings, and natural phenomena.
- [Reviews](https://gizmodo.com/reviews): Evaluations and recommendations for products and digital services.
- [io9](https://gizmodo.com/io9): Entertainment journalism focused on speculative fiction and pop culture franchises.
- [Deals](https://gizmodo.com/deals): Commerce coverage highlighting discounts and shopping opportunities in tech categories.
